name: objective
description: A direction SemanticOps commits to; periods rank objectives and epic priority follows the rank.

aiGuidance.purpose: One outcome the project works toward, stated so that an epic can be said to serve it.
aiGuidance.extraction: Create one per outcome the owner names. Title is the outcome in plain words; summary one sentence; body markdown for the reasoning.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Not a task or an epic, and carries no rank: rank lives on the period.
